reason: When I need something it is because I need it now, a gift or a part, and two to three weeks is exactly the waiting I already hate. On top of that I have to pay up front to a page I have never heard of.
objection: Three weeks is too long for what I need, and paying the item price first to a new service scares me after my cousin lost her deposit to a page that disappeared.
would_change_my_mind: A guaranteed delivery in under 10 days, or letting me pay everything on delivery, with a real office I can visit first.
